identity.title: Does the Christian God Exist? Trent Horn vs. Dan Barker Debate
identity.dateBasis: Public upload description identifies the September 24, 2018 event at Minnesota State University Mankato; upload date November 27, 2018.
identity.speakerIdentityBasis: Public source metadata and mutually named primary speakers; full-source and targeted timestamped audio transcription.

acquisition.method: Timestamped OpenAI Whisper transcription of the complete public audio, with authenticated shorter-clip substitutions and explicitly editor-approved formal-rounds/closing scope

content.coverageNote: This assessment covers the formal openings, rebuttals, and cross-examination (approximately 0:23–1:15:34), plus both closing statements (1:49:54–2:00:22). The entire audience Q&A and both speakers' answers are excluded because some audience wording remains uncertain and some interventions introduce substantive arguments. Neither speaker receives credit or penalty for excluded material; these scores assess the approved formal-rounds-and-closings scope, not the complete event.
content.captionCaution: Whisper does not label speakers. Original and verification results are preserved. Recognition errors in technical names and verse references are not silently corrected or treated as participant failures. Review mixed turns before locking attribution; no omitted Q&A response can be scored as silence.

Closing claims must stand on their own or on retained formal-round evidence; excluded audience premises and responses may supply neither evidence nor an alleged unanswered objection.
